changes: Added a full ticket system (ported from Drako Bot): `/panel` posts a ticket panel with an open button per ticket type (java, br, bug, report, partnership); opening a ticket creates a private `panel-username` channel under the support category visible only to the opener, staff and managers, with one open ticket per user per type.

Tickets can be closed with the 🔒 button in the channel or `/close` (staff). Closing renames the channel to `closed-…` (which the existing detector already understands) and staff get 🔓 reopen and 🗑️ delete buttons. Deleting saves a transcript and removes the channel after 5 seconds.

Ticket transcripts are generated as a styled HTML file — full message history with authors, avatars, timestamps, attachment links and embed summaries — and posted to the configured log channel whenever a ticket is closed or deleted. No new dependencies.

Added `/purge count:<1-100> user:<optional>` for staff with Manage Messages: bulk deletes recent messages (optionally from one member only), logs the purge, and auto-deletes its own confirmation after 5 seconds. Messages older than 14 days are skipped, as Discord requires.
Added `/snipe` — shows the most recently deleted message in the current channel (author, content, attachments, deletion time, kept for 6 hours). Staff only.
Added `/addrole user:<member> role:<role>` and `/removerole` — quick role management with logging and role-hierarchy safety checks.

Added `/poll question:<text> options:<comma-separated> duration:<optional>` — creates a numbered button-vote poll; with a duration (`10m`, `2h`, `3d`) the results are posted automatically when it ends, winner marked with 🏆. One vote per person.
Added `/remind in:<90s|10m|2h|3d> text:<what>` — personal reminders stored in the database, so they survive bot restarts, delivered in the channel they were set in.
The `/help` command now lists all the new commands in their categories.
